topic: Learning the Rules at the Dog Park

script.title: AT THE DOG PARK
script.story_hook: A first visit turns a nervous puppy into a star.
script.intro_zh: 第一次帶小狗去公園,把規矩一次聽懂。
script.welcome_en: Hi! Today: the rules of a neighborhood dog park.
script.welcome_zh: 你好!今天來學社區狗公園的規則對話。
script.outro: Sixty lines, and both tails are wagging.
script.outro_zh: 六十句聽完,兩條尾巴都在搖。
script.practice_intro_en: Now your turn — repeat every line happily.
script.practice_intro_zh: 換你了,開開心心地跟著唸。
script.char_a_description: a young man in his early twenties with shaggy light brown hair under a baseball cap, wearing an olive hoodie, cuffed jeans and muddy boots, thin build, carrying a retractable leash with a tiny puppy
script.char_b_description: a retired woman in her seventies with short white curly hair, wearing a bright orange windbreaker, beige trekking pants and sturdy hiking shoes, tall upright build, holding a leather leash at her side

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! Which gate is for small dogs?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ wɪtʃ ɡeɪt ɪz fər smɔl dɔɡz/
dialogue.zh: 你好!哪個閘門是給小型犬的?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That green one, sweetie. Not this brown.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɡrin wʌn ˈswiti nɑt ðɪs braʊn/
dialogue.zh: 是綠色那個,孩子。不是這個棕色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops. I nearly walked into the giants.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊps aɪ ˈnɪrli wɔkt ˈɪntu ðə ˈdʒaɪənts/
dialogue.zh: 糟了,我剛剛差點走進大狗區。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every newcomer does. I'm Rita.
dialogue.zh: 每個新手都會這樣。我叫麗塔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam. This is my new puppy, Momo.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm ðɪs ɪz maɪ njuː ˈpʌpi ˈmoʊmoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我是山姆,這是我家新養的小狗莫摩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Momo? Adorable. Big hearts, small legs.
dialogue.zh: 莫摩?太可愛了,心很大,腿很短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So — what are the rules here?
dialogue.zh: 那這裡的規矩有哪些呢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rule one: make sure both gates are shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /rul wʌn meɪk ʃʊr boʊθ ɡeɪts ɑr ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 第一條:確認前後兩道門都關好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The double gate's a safety room?
dialogue.zh: 這道雙門是一個安全緩衝區嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. It's an airlock — no bolt-outs.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯,像氣閘一樣,防止狗狗衝出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good point. Leashes on or off?
dialogue.zh: 有道理。牽繩是要繫著還是解開?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once you're inside, off you go.
dialogue.zh: 進了內場,就可以解開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Off? Just like that?
dialogue.zh: 直接解開?就這樣?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just like that. They read body language.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst laɪk ðæt ðeɪ rid ˈbɑdi ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 就這樣。狗狗們看得懂肢體語言。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Momo, free little guy.
dialogue.zh: 莫摩,去自由奔跑吧,小傢伙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water's there, but it's… muddy today.
dialogue.zh: 水碗在那邊,不過今天水都混泥巴了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I fetch fresh water from my car?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ fɛtʃ fræʃ ˈwɔtər frʌm maɪ kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 我該從車上搬瓶乾淨水來嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a tap by the bench.
dialogue.zh: 長椅旁邊就有一個水龍頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Solved. Bags? The station's empty again.
dialogue.zh: 解決了。撿便袋呢?袋子站又空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty again! Here, take half of mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmpti əˈɡɛn hɪr teɪk hæf əv maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 又空啦!來,我的分你一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a legend. How many do I need?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ə ˈlɛdʒənd haʊ ˈmɛni du aɪ nid/
dialogue.zh: 你真是救星。一次要帶幾袋?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One per poop, plus one for emergencies.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pər puːp plʌz wʌn fər ɪˈmɜrdʒənzɪz/
dialogue.zh: 上廁所一次一袋,再多帶一袋以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted. Oh — that huge dog's coming over!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd oʊ ðæt hjuːdʒ dɔɡz ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈoʊvər/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。噢——那隻超大狗走過來了!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's Bruno. Big, but polite.
dialogue.zh: 那是布魯諾,個子大,禮貌更大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He just licked Momo's whole face.
dialogue.zh: 他剛把莫摩的整張臉舔了一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bruno's hello. Very wet, very kind.
dialogue.zh: 這是布魯諾的招呼方式,濕透了,但很溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Momo's not scared — he's wagging!
dialogue.zh: 莫摩才不怕呢——尾巴搖個不停!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Rule two: a play bow means friendly.
dialogue.phonetic: /si rul tu ə pleɪ baʊ minz ˈfrɛndli/
dialogue.zh: 看見了吧?第二條:邀玩的姿勢就是友善。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The front-down, back-up thing?
dialogue.zh: 就是前半身前傾、屁股翹起來的那個動作?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You studied! Front down, bottom up.
dialogue.zh: 你有做功課!前胸壓下,後臀翹高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if a dog gets too rough?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ə dɔɡ ɡɛts tu rʌf/
dialogue.zh: 如果有狗玩得太粗魯呢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blow the whistle — the keeper answers.
dialogue.zh: 吹那支哨子,管理員就會過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A keeper? Like a referee?
dialogue.zh: 管理員?像裁判那樣的人?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better — he breaks up drama fast.
dialogue.zh: 比裁判更厲害,他很快就拆散糾紛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Can I give Momo treats?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我可以給莫摩吃零食嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Park rule: no treats near the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑrk rul noʊ trits nɪr ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 公園規定:門口附近不準餵食。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not? He behaved so well!
dialogue.zh: 為什麼?他今天表現超好的!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Food starts squabbles. Wait by the bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /fud stɑrts ˈskwɑbəz weɪt baɪ ðə bɛntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 食物會引起爭吵。去長椅邊再餵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough. What about rainy days?
dialogue.zh: 有道理。那下雨天該怎麼辦?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mud season — a towel lives in my car.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌd ˈsizən ə ˈtaʊəl lɪvz ɪn maɪ kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 泥巴季嘛——我的車裡常駐一條毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm taking notes. Is there a vet nearby?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈteɪkɪŋ noʊts ɪz ðɛr ə vɛt ˈnɪrbaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我在記重點了。附近有獸醫嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A twenty-four-hour clinic, ten minutes away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtwɛnti fɔr ˈaʊər ˈklɪnɪk tɛn ˈmɪnəts əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 有一家二十四小時診所,開車十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you text it to me, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju tɛkst ɪt tə mi pliz/
dialogue.zh: 可以傳簡訊給我嗎?拜託。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already typed. Number saved.
dialogue.zh: 已經打好了。號碼存進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fast! And vaccines — are they checked?
dialogue.zh: 好快!那疫苗呢,這裡會檢查嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yearly, at the gate. Show the tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjɪrli æt ðə ɡeɪt ʃoʊ ðə tæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 每年一次,在門口出示吊牌就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Momo got his last Tuesday.
dialogue.zh: 莫摩上週二才剛打過針。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you're a real member now.
dialogue.zh: 那你們現在是正式的會員了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Member? This place has regulars?
dialogue.zh: 會員?這裡還有固定班底啊?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small-dog walk, Saturdays, nine sharp.
dialogue.zh: 週六九點整,有一場小型犬散步團。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Momo too small for a walk?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈmoʊmoʊ tu smɔl fər ə wɔk/
dialogue.zh: 莫摩會不會太小,走不了散步?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short legs, big pace. He'll manage.
dialogue.zh: 腿短步頻快,他撐得住的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Saturday, nine, green gate.
dialogue.zh: 完美。週六九點,綠色閘門見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's my new favorite chant.
dialogue.zh: 這句口號我愛上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, Rita. Bruno, nice to meet you.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ˈritə ˈbruːnoʊ naɪs tə mi tuː/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝妳,麗塔。布魯諾,很高興認識你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says hello back — with slobber.
dialogue.zh: 她說回你好——用一嘴口水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Worth it. Same time next week?
dialogue.zh: 值得啦。下週同一時間見?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same gate. Bring the poop bags!
dialogue.zh: 同一個門。記得帶撿便袋!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already in my pocket. Bye, everyone!
dialogue.zh: 早就放口袋了。大家再見!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye, Sam. Momo's a star already.
dialogue.zh: 再見,山姆。莫摩已經是小明星了。

script.youtube_description_en:
"Bruno's hello. Very wet, very kind." — the warmest warning at the dog park. In this 60-line A2 listening animation, a first-time puppy owner meets a friendly regular who teaches him every park rule: the small-dog gate, the airlock double gate, when leashes come off, an empty bag station rescued by a spare roll, the muddy water bowl, the keeper's whistle, treat rules near the gate, vaccine tags, and a Saturday small-dog walk invitation. Listen line by line, then repeat every sentence out loud in the shadowing chapter. Playful, practical, and packed with real community-park English. No memorizing — just listen often. Designed for A2 learners. Subscribe and tap the bell for a new immersive English listening animation every week!
